>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/apilogs/summary"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Totals the organization's LLM gateway calls per day between `start_date` and `end_date` (inclusive, at most 92 days apart), with days counted in the time zone `tz`. Only days with calls are listed. With `by_key=true`, each day is also broken down by API key. 400 for a missing or invalid date, range or time zone. Login tokens only: API keys get 401.
